title: JoshMemory Record: First remediation wave COMPLETE. AIDungeonMaster PR #7 merged and verified on mai

events.text: JoshMemory Record: First remediation wave COMPLETE. AIDungeonMaster PR #7 merged and verified on main (SHA 75ed1f9). Tests and lint pass. SecurityAudit register updated. Phase 2 validation begun: extracted 10 top-priority distinct investigations.
